records.text: The TPUSA Tampa event was a disaster; Michele Bachmann was booed and about 10% of attendees walked out when she spoke about standing with Israel.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep gG4ZoYUjUc8)

appearances.snippet: Your TPUSA Tampa event was a disaster. Michele Bachmann was booed and about 10% walked out on her when she talked about standing with Israel. You brag about how you convinced all these young voters to vote for Trump (Donald J. Trump), but you can't convince them to stand with our Jewish brethren?

verification.notes: Transcript context identifies this as another assertion inside the purported anonymous donor message. Current searches found no independent event report or attendance evidence confirming that Bachmann was booed and that about 10 percent walked out at the Tampa event.

conveyance.original_source: Text message sent to Charlie Kirk

records.text: Ten percent of the room got up and walked out while Michele Bachmann argued for supporting Israel at the Turning Point USA conference.
records.speaker: Michele Bachmann

appearances.snippet: Right after him comes Michelle Bachmann. ... Michelle (Michelle Bachmann) has five minutes to make an argument for why we have to stand with Israel to these young people at TPUSA. ... When she starts talking in that conference about supporting Israel and why America should stand with Israel, ... the people in the audience start booing her. ... I spoke with her personally. ... She said 10%. ... in the room got up and walked out on her.

verification.notes: The source statement is explicitly Michele Bachmanns estimate relayed by another speaker. Available event video and reporting do not provide an attendee count or measured walkout percentage, so the 10 percent figure cannot be verified.

sources.relevance: Full event video documents the speech but does not provide a reliable attendance count or demonstrate that ten percent walked out.

conveyance.original_source: Private conversation described in Lori Cardoza-Moore video

records.text: Did Charlie Kirk condemn Tucker Carlson or defend Michele Bachmann after the conference remarks? No, he did not.
records.speaker: Laurie Cardoza-Moore

appearances.snippet: Then Charlie Kirk. ... Does he get up and condemn Tucker (Tucker Carlson) or correct Tucker (Tucker Carlson) for what he said about Israel and how dangerous Qatar is to us? No. ... Did Charlie (Charlie Kirk) get up and defend Michelle Bachmann? ... No, ... he didn't.

verification.notes: The allegation depends on proving an absence across Kirks later public and private communications: that he never condemned Carlson and never defended Bachmann. Current public sources do not establish that universal negative, so it is not verifiable.
